jobs.description: Job description Today, the Finance & Operations team at Maki is two people. Together we cover finance and operations, including HR and part of legal, across three entities: France, the UK and the US. That means this internship isn't a back-office job: it's a front-row seat. You will be our first Finance & Operations intern, working hand in hand with our Founding FP&A, who you report to directly, on the processes and numbers that keep the company running across three jurisdictions. You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, get into the detail, and own real work from week one. Nothing here is theoretical. If you want breadth rather than a narrow slice, and you'd rather build processes than inherit them, this is your opportunity. 💪 About your mission Finance operations: Support day-to-day finance: client billing, supplier payments, cash management and financial documents. Reporting & analysis: Contribute to monthly reporting (P&L and cash), to management reports commenting on business performance, and to KPI tracking for board and investor reporting. Planning: Support budgeting and forecasting. People operations: Contribute to the employee lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, HR documents and employee records. Legal and contracts: Help prepare and track contracts and corporate documents. Be the first answer: Act as the first line of response for the team's day-to-day administrative questions. Build, don't just maintain: Formalise and improve our processes and tools so they scale with the company. Ad hoc projects: Support the team on both one-off and strategic topics. We're looking for someone who wants to understand how a company actually works, not just one function of it. jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Key Responsibilities: Communication & Stakeholder Management: Act as the vital bridge between technical data architecture and business-focused enterprise treasury operations, translating complex data findings into clear, non-technical insights. Proactively communicate with cross-regional teams (finance, engineering, and global treasury) across multiple time zones, ensuring alignment on data definitions, reporting requirements, and project timelines. Draft clear, concise documentation for data pipelines, dashboard usage, and reporting metrics to ensure global teams can easily understand and leverage your tools. Present analytical findings and AI/ML capabilities confidently to both the Manager and broader global stakeholders. Data Modeling & Technical Execution: Take technical requirements translated by the Manager and develop robust data pipelines and models to support treasury operations. Extract, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) complex datasets using modern tech stacks including dbt , Google BigQuery , and Snowflake . Ensure data architecture

Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to  spark your growth with us? This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys the technical side of IFRS, is comfortable in a consolidation tool, and likes turning complex multi-entity data into accurate, timely numbers. As part of our global hiring process, we kindly ask that resumes/CVs be submitted in English, as it’s our primary business language across teams and regions.    WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Own the European sub-consolidation Prepare and load consolidation entries in the consolidation system for the European perimeter, including purchase price allocation, intercompany eliminations and IFRS adjustments. jobs.description: Retire the ERP At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity. In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use. You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative. The Role Own the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team. Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track. Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system. Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks. Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product. jobs.title: Country Executive
jobs.description: Country Executive The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring. Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job. Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week. What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours. This Is Not A Country Manager Role. Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else. No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM. What You’ll Be Doing Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against. Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.
